pages.text: The Crafting Grid is similar to a regular Grid but includes a crafting inventory. It allows you to craft items using materials from your storage network.

Features:$(li)All features of a regular Grid$(li)Integrated crafting inventory$(li)JEI recipe transfer support$(li)Automatic item retrieval from network$(li)CTRL + CLICK to start autocrafting missing items

To use the Crafting Grid:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Right-click to open the interface$(li)Use JEI to transfer recipes$(li)CTRL + CLICK missing items to start autocrafting$(li)Use the crafting grid to craft items
You can recolor the Crafting Grid in two ways:$(li)Using a dye on the Crafting Grid$(li)Combining the block with a dye in a crafting recipe
